name: Se.Kirara
source:
Saki finally made it into Soushin Gakuen with the help and encouragement of his friends. Lifted by his achievement, he feels that it is just one small milestone in his life and he should do the most he can with his life. But everything won’t go smoothly. Together with the girls he meets at the school, he will make the journey to maturity.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

This is the first non-doujin game that will be available for free. You can also get the game bundled with a figma from Max Factory for 2800 yen.
translation:
咲在朋友的帮助与鼓励下，终于考入奏心学园。这一成就令他振奋，但他认为这只是人生中的一座小小里程碑，自己应当尽可能充实地生活。然而一切不会一帆风顺。他将与在学校遇见的女孩们一同踏上走向成熟的旅程。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

这是第一款免费提供的非同人游戏。玩家也可以购买由Max Factory发行、与figma捆绑销售的版本，售价2800日元。
